stock.description: KPa-BM Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, predominantly engaged in providing structural engineering solutions. The firm concentrates specifically on design-and-build projects for both private and government entities, primarily across Hong Kong and mainland China. Its operations are divided into three main business segments: structural engineering services, the provision and installation of building material products, and the trading of such products. Additionally, the company undertakes the processing, fabrication, manufacturing, and installation of various building materials, alongside managing property investments and trademark holdings. KPa-BM Holdings also offers specialized fabrication drawing services. It serves a wide array of sectors including residential, commercial, industrial, educational, and infrastructure development. Established in 1991, the company's headquarters are situated in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong, and it operates as a subsidiary of Success Wing Investments Limited.
